item.title: Munster beaten at Toulon
item.description: There was heartbreak for both Irish sides in European rugby action today. Munster have fallen to a 27-25 defeat to Toulon in their Champions Cup match. Tom Farrell scored a try with five minutes to go to give Munster the lead but a penalty has given the French side the victory. Advertisement Meanwhile, Connacht let a big lead slip and were beaten by Montpellier in the Challenge Cup. They allowed their opponents to score 19 unanswered points with Montpellier coming out on top by 33 points to 31.

item.title: Hearts re-establish six-point lead
item.description: Hearts have re-established a six-point lead at the top of the Scottish Premiership - for a short time at least - with a 1-nil win at Dundee. The leaders played the second half with 10 men after goalkeeper Alexander Schwolow was sent off just before the break. Rangers will move back to second if they avoid defeat at Aberdeen this afternoon. Advertisement

item.title: An Ghaeltacht capture All-Ireland title
item.description: An Ghaeltacht are AIB All Ireland Intermediate Club football champions. They were dominant in the final at Croke Park against Glenullin, Derry. An Ghaeltacht won by 12 points to 6. Advertisement Ruaidhri O'Beaglaoich had the first point of the decider, for the Kerry champions. Sean O'Cuinn double the advantage after 6 minutes, then Glenullin opened their account. item.title: Drugs, firearm and knife seized in searches across Killarney
item.description: A large quantity of drugs, along with a suspected firearm and knife were seized from several locations across Killarney yesterday afternoon. This was part of an an intelligence-led operation, by the Kerry Divisional Drugs Unit, as part of Operation Tara. As part of the operation, Gardaí stopped and searched a vehicle in Killarney at approximately 2:50pm and seized €5,000 worth of suspected cannabis, a knife and a number of electronic devices of evidential value. item.title: Killarney's Jessie Buckley in the running for a Golden Globe award tonight
item.description: Eyes in the Kingdom will be on Los Angeles tonight, as Killarney's Jessie Buckley is in the running for a Golden Globe award. The 36 year-old is up for Best Performance by a Female Actor in a Motion Picture in the drama category. She has been nominated for her role in Hamnet, where she played the wife of William Shakespeare opposite Paul Mescal. item.title: Kerry TD criticises Government’s response to rising energy prices
item.description: A Kerry TD has criticised the government and the regulator for their failure to address Ireland’s rising energy prices. Sinn Féin spokesperson on Energy, Pa Daly TD says that Irish households are being “fleeced” and “forced to pay €360 more per year for electricity than other European countries”. This comes following a new report by the Nevin Economic Research Institute. item.title: All Ireland glory for An Ghaeltacht and Ballymacelligott
item.description: Two Kerry teams have achieved All Ireland glory this afternoon. A superb second half display saw Ballymacelligott defeat Clogher Eire Og of Tyrone in the final of the AIB All Ireland Junior Club Football Championship. Ballymac won by 1-16 to 0-13. Advertisement In addition to this An Ghaeltacht are AIB All Ireland Intermediate Club football champions. They put in a dominant performance in Croke Park against Glenullin, Derry, winning by 12 points to 6.
